Application Data.NAME: Smith & Sons Windows and Doors
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith & Sons Windows and Doors specializes in the installation and sale of high-quality doors and windows for residential and commercial properties. Our services include free consultations, precise measurements, and expert installation by our trained staff. We offer a wide range of products, from energy-efficient windows to elegant entry doors, ensuring that we meet the varying needs and preferences of our customers. Safety and customer satisfaction are our top priorities, and we adhere to all industry standards throughout our operations.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, a customer reported damage to their property during window installation, caused by an unexpected wind gust that blew a ladder over. The estimated cost to repair the damage was $3,000. The claim was filed, and the status is currently "Pending." Additionally, on August 22, 2022, there was a minor incident where a subcontractor accidentally chipped a doorframe while transporting materials, resulting in a repair cost of $2,000. This incident was resolved, and the status is "Closed.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: High-Security Composite Safe, Class B, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and 24-hour on-site watchperson during business hours.
